milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the red tulip and face it, modeling 'player can see the target.' The red tulip is at spawn-relative (8, 0, 7), about 10.6 blocks from spawn. A max_distance of 5 ensures the player is close enough to have clearly found it, and facing_tolerance of 60° confirms they are looking at it. This spatially excludes the poppy distractor at (-6, 0, 3) and the orange tulip at (3, 0, 6).
